steps: Prepare the overall audit strategy (scope, timing, team)
Prepare the detailed audit plan by area
Brief the team and record attendance
items.text: Overall audit strategy and detailed audit plan documented and communicated to the team.

items.how: Materiality worksheet; summary of uncorrected misstatements.
steps: Choose the benchmark (profit, revenue or assets) and compute overall materiality
Set performance materiality and the clearly-trivial threshold
Document reasons for the percentages used
items.text: Overall materiality, performance materiality and the 'clearly trivial' threshold set with reasons.

items.how: Risk register mapped to audit programme.
steps: Identify risks of material misstatement by area and assertion
Mark significant risks, including revenue recognition and management override
Link each risk to the audit response in the programme
items.text: Risks of material misstatement assessed at the assertion level, with responses linked to each risk.

items.how: Fraud inquiry memo; JE testing working paper.
steps: Enquire of management and those charged with governance about fraud
Select and test journal entries (manual, period-end, unusual accounts)
Review estimates and unusual transactions for bias
items.text: Fraud inquiries made with management and those charged with governance; journal entry testing done; revenue recognition presumption addressed.

steps: List laws with a direct effect on the financial statements
Test compliance and enquire about non-compliance
Obtain management representation on compliance
items.text: Compliance with laws having a direct effect on the financial statements reviewed; non-compliance evaluated.

steps: Prepare the communication of significant findings to those charged with governance
List significant control deficiencies
Issue the management letter in writing
items.text: Matters communicated to those charged with governance; significant control deficiencies reported in writing.

steps: Attend the physical count or perform roll-forward / roll-back
Test count sheets to the final stock list
Send litigation enquiry letters to the client's lawyers
items.text: Physical verification of inventory attended or alternative procedures done; litigation and claims enquired.

items.how: Confirmation log with replies and reconciliations.
steps: Prepare the list of balances to confirm (banks, debtors, creditors, loans)
Send requests under auditor's control and log replies
Reconcile differences and perform alternative procedures for non-replies
items.text: External confirmations sent and reconciled for banks, debtors, creditors, loans and investments.

items.how: Comparison with prior-year audited FS; predecessor's papers reviewed.
steps: Compare opening balances with prior-year audited financial statements
Review the predecessor's working papers where available
Check accounting policies are consistent
items.text: Opening balances verified for an initial engagement (carried forward correctly, policies consistent).

items.how: Ratio and variance analysis with explanations.
steps: Compute key ratios and year-on-year variances at planning
Obtain explanations for large variances
Repeat the analysis at the final review stage
items.text: Analytical procedures done at planning and at the overall review stage; large variances explained.

steps: Define the population and sampling unit for each test
Record sample size and selection method
Evaluate and project the errors found
items.text: Sample sizes and selection method documented for tests of details.

steps: List significant estimates (provisions, impairment, ECL, useful lives)
Test management's method, data and assumptions
Develop an independent estimate or range where possible
items.text: Accounting estimates (provisions, impairment, expected credit loss, useful lives) tested for reasonableness.

steps: Obtain the list of related parties and compare with MBP-1 / registers
Test related-party transactions for approval and pricing
Check disclosures are complete
items.text: Related parties identified and transactions tested for authorisation, pricing and disclosure.

items.how: Subsequent events checklist; minutes after year end.
steps: Review minutes, ledgers and bank statements after year end
Enquire about subsequent events up to the report date
Record adjusting and non-adjusting events
items.text: Subsequent events reviewed up to the date of the audit report.

items.how: Going concern memo; cash-flow forecast reviewed.
steps: Obtain management's going concern assessment
Review cash-flow forecasts, borrowing headroom and indicators
Conclude and decide on any report modification or disclosure
items.text: Going concern assessment by management evaluated; indicators documented.

steps: Draft the representation letter covering all required matters
Obtain it signed and dated close to the report date
File the signed letter
items.text: Written representations obtained, dated as near as possible to the report date.

steps: Identify where other auditors, internal auditors or experts are relied on
Evaluate their competence and objectivity
Review their work and document the reliance
items.text: Use of other auditors, internal auditors or experts (valuers, actuaries) evaluated and documented.

items.how: Draft audit report reviewed by engagement partner.
steps: Summarise uncorrected misstatements and limitation of scope
Decide the type of opinion and any emphasis / other matter paragraphs
Partner reviews and approves the draft report
items.text: Opinion type decided; basis for modification, emphasis of matter and other matter paragraphs drafted where needed.

steps: Check comparatives agree with prior-year figures
Read the directors' report and other information
Record any material inconsistency and its resolution
items.text: Comparatives checked; other information (directors' report) read for material inconsistency.
